title: Wordtracker: your competitors show up in AI answers. Do you?

facts.fact: Wordtracker's Full plan costs $99 a month when billed monthly, which the page says totals $1,188 a year.
facts.quote: $99 a month Billed monthly, $1,188 a year

facts.fact: Wordtracker's Full plan costs $66 a month when billed yearly, billed once a year at $792, with the page stating a yearly saving of $396.
facts.quote: $66 a month ~instead of $99~ $792 billed once a year You save $396 a year

facts.fact: Wordtracker's Starter plan costs $49 a month when billed monthly, which the page says totals $588 a year.
facts.quote: $49 a month Billed monthly, $588 a year

facts.fact: Wordtracker's Starter plan costs $33 a month when billed yearly, billed once a year at $392, with the page stating a yearly saving of $196.
facts.quote: $33 a month ~instead of $49~ $392 billed once a year You save $196 a year

facts.fact: Wordtracker's Free plan costs nothing and includes 3 searches a day, 3 AI questions asked once at set-up, and 1 business.
facts.quote: 3 searches a day 3 AI questions, asked once at set-up 1 business

facts.fact: Wordtracker's Starter plan includes 20 AI questions checked weekly and 100 tracked keywords per site across 3 sites.
facts.quote: 100 tracked keywords a site, on 3 sites, weekly 20 AI questions, checked weekly

facts.fact: Wordtracker's paid plans return up to 2,000 results per keyword search.
facts.quote: Up to 2,000 results a search, to sort, filter, save and export

facts.fact: Wordtracker states that customers can cancel any time and receive a full refund within 14 days.
facts.quote: Cancel any time. Full refund within 14 days.

facts.fact: Wordtracker's free report asks 3 AI questions once, while the $99 plan asks up to 25 questions every week.
facts.quote: Your free report asks 3 questions this way, once; on $99, up to 25 are asked every week.

facts.fact: Wordtracker's AI visibility method asks each buyer question 5 times on each of 5 AI engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Mode).
facts.quote: Your buyers' questions are asked 5 times on each of ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Mode

facts.fact: Wordtracker's Free plan and free report cost nothing and do not require a credit card.
facts.quote: Yes. Your report and the Free plan cost nothing, and we don't ask for a card.

facts.fact: In Wordtracker's sample report, the keyword 'paddle board trolley uk' is shown with 75 searches a month in the United Kingdom.
facts.quote: paddle board trolley uk · 75 searches a month

facts.fact: In Wordtracker's sample keyword table for 'paddle board' in the United Kingdom, 'paddle boarding near me' has 12,300 monthly searches.
In Wordtracker's sample data, the Suspenz brand is named in 37 of 50 answers to the example buyer question on ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Mode.
Wordtracker's sample report shows Shore Ride named in 2% of AI answers over the last two weeks.
Wordtracker's Free plan limits each search preview to a 3-row preview.
